Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. Gaia DR2 plus Lowell inversion; publication table gives334 Lowell and20 Gaia points. Both poles remain; model3844 is representative. This is a coarse convex inverse model with an approximate thermal size. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
